The change that made the setting take effect is commit `4cc27d388fb4a4fe49316791a20127dbb04e31ae` (PR #1920, ticket O3-6028). It passes `chooseLocation.locationsPerRequest` to the login location picker and removes the unused `chooseLocation.numberToShow` option.

The line that passes it to the picker is `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/location-picker/location-picker-view.component.tsx:181`:

```tsx
locationsPerRequest={Math.max(chooseLocation.locationsPerRequest, 1)}
```

The value is clamped to at least 1. Before this commit, the picker used its own default of 50 (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/location-picker/location-picker.component.tsx:27`), so the configured value was never passed in.

Supporting evidence:
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/config-schema.ts:44-48` defines `locationsPerRequest` (default 50). Lines 41-46 in the same file show `numberToShow` being removed.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/location-picker/location-picker.test.tsx:435-459` adds tests that check the configured value reaches the picker, and that 0 falls back to 1.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/login.resource.ts` drops the old `useLoginLocations` hook in the same commit. The page size now comes only from the picker's `locationsPerRequest` prop.
- `openmrs-esm-core/.changeset/login-locations-per-request.md` is the changeset for the fix.

I did not modify any files.
